text:
drew: quick ping 1: saw anchor-shift and small duplications while onboarding kite-20b-int4 on long-doc tests. reproducer uses 55k ctx and a repeated 5-token anchor. suspect RoPE index misalignment after a tiled quant pack. collecting artifacts.

frank: can you paste the exact command and build sha? also which kernel (portable/fastpath) and kv-mode?

drew: running on staging fastpath (nvfuser), cmd: `./long_eval --model=kite-20b-int4 --ctx=55000 --repeat=20 --kv-mode=staging --seed=13 --kv-trace=rotable,kvcache` build: sha: b7f4c2a

snippet from small repro log: 
```
[2026-03-26T23:04:11Z] rotable: pos=54996 freq_idx=219984 -> ok
[2026-03-26T23:04:11Z] rotable: pos=54997 freq_idx=219985 -> ok
[2026-03-26T23:04:12Z] rotable: pos=54998 freq_idx=219986 -> ok
[2026-03-26T23:04:12Z] rotable: pos=54999 freq_idx=219987 -> ok
[2026-03-26T23:04:12Z] rotable: pos=55000 freq_idx=0 -> WARN: wrapped/alias
[2026-03-26T23:04:12Z] gen: "...she lifted the lid" -> "...she lifted the lid she lifted"  <-- anchor shift/dup
```
I uploaded kvcache dump + micro harness to s3://redwood-qa/triage/1810001234/

anya: that freq_idx=0 at pos 55000 is suspicious. sounds like an integer truncation or an accidental modulo when computing the rotable offset from token_pos. did you try int8 or a portable kernel?

drew: i re-ran the same harness on portable kernel and int8 build; no repro in ~30 runs. int4 fastpath reproduces ~15-20% runs.

frank: likely in quant-pack fast-path. recent perf CL swapped a `size_t`->`uint32_t` cast in pack_stride computation to speed up SIMD helpers. if stride computation is in bytes and we later convert to token positions, any >32k value could overflow.

eng-runtime-bot: CI:long-onboard/1810001234 started. matrix: quant=[int4,int8], kernel=[fastpath,portable], ctxs=[55000,55001,65536]. artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/long-onboard/1810001234

anya: triage plan: 1) @drew run micro-harness with `--kv-index-type=uint64 --pack-stride-check=on --alloc-sanitizer=on` to confirm overflow; 2) @frank bisect CLs touching quant-pack and fastpath kernels (CLs 6001..6030); 3) add a short unit test that appends the anchor across the 55k boundary and asserts monotonic rotable indices; 4) if confirmed, land assertion in kvcache and a temporary guard that disables the packed fastpath for ctx>32768 until fix.

drew: starting step 1 now, uploading results to artifacts.

frank: i'll prep a debug build that forces 64-bit indices and run the bisect. quick note: if changing the index width changes performance significantly, we can instead ensure pack_stride_bytes keeps using 64-bit for intermediate arithmetic and only narrow for storage if safe.

ci-bot: CI results: fastpath/int4/55000 reproduced (dup) 7/50, portable/int4/55000 0/50, int8 variants 0/100. Debug build with `--kv-index-type=uint64` for fastpath/int4 showed 0/50 reproductions.

anya: that's a clear signal for overflow/truncation. creating BUG-ML-5200 (kite20b-int4-rope-index-truncation) and assigning to @frank + @eng-runtime for fix and regression. P1 for staging/dedicated hold until hotfix.

drew: attached the mini repro harness and a minimal failing input to the bug. also added a short CI job to long-ctx-smoke to run the anchor harness across quant variants nightly.

frank: plan for fix: revert the `uint32_t` local cast in pack_stride computation, add bounds-check asserts in kvcache accessors (fail loudly in debug), and add unit test to CI. i'll measure perf impact and try to land a micro-optimizing alternative that preserves 64-bit intermediates. will post candidate patch and canary binary here.

anya: thanks. once we have the candidate, coordinate a targeted canary rollout to staging/dedicated hosts. also please add telemetry so we can detect similar repeats in hosted production (signal: repeated 5-token anchor within 4 tokens).

frank: ack. opening PR now and adding the regression test. will ping once CI green and canary binary ready.

drew: thanks all. ping back here with patch sha or repro binary and i'll coordinate the verification runs and hotfix plan. :thumbsup:
